definitions.explanation: The height of a person, measured from feet to head. The everyday way of referring to how tall someone is.

examples.japanese: {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧くらいです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずいぶん⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Even though they're brothers, their heights differ quite a bit.

examples.japanese: {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：10973_chuugakusei⟧⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぐんと⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many children's height shoots up around the time they're in middle school.

notes:
Literally "the tallness of one's back/torso." The everyday phrase; the single noun ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧ is more formal and used on forms and medical charts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure someone's height
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: heights differ
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧くらい: about the same height
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up by height

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧: height (formal) — used on forms, medical records, official descriptions
- ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to be tall — the adjective expression, not the noun
- ⟦{背丈|せたけ}→背丈：16140_setake⟧: stature — somewhat literary; emphasizes overall build
